evidence.scope: Supplier/tool evidence only; not customer demand or validation.
evidence.quote: 1.5% + €0.25 for standard European Economic Area cards

uncertainty: No parent recruitment, testing, repeat requests or other market validation has occurred.
Daily availability of suitable Iļģuciems outings is unknown.
Incremental usefulness over original municipal listings and existing parent-group sharing is untested.
Checker availability, bilingual accuracy and minutes required per verified card are unknown.
No supplied costs establish a sustainable operating budget; future payer and revenue remain undefined.
dissent: A small seasonal pilot could be worthwhile even without daily inventory or a revenue model: requesting another card is a reasonable early signal for a deliberately free service.
Manual verification may initially be appropriate; demanding extensive automation before testing usefulness would add unnecessary work.
